description: 국토교통부_버스노선별 경유정류장 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 버스 노선별 경유 정류장 정보는 특정 노선이 어떤 정류장에 어떤 순서로 정차하는지를 상세히 제공하는 자료로, 승객이 경로를 명확히 파악하고 효율적으로 목적지에 도달할 수 있도록 돕습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 버스노선별경유정류장, 경유정류장, 정류장순서, 버스정류장정보, 노선정차정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
